review.notes: Checked all 15 hat definitions twice against authoritative English source. Preserved boolean/hide flags, empty fields, tailoring/order IDs, slash layouts, and duplicated display-name fields exactly in structure; retained the intentional mystery record byte-for-byte. Names and descriptions received two editorial passes for concise natural Greek, correct item agreement and materials, source humor, and current Abigail, Joja, Gil, and Mummy terminology.
